methods.name: flame.deliverables/append.v1
methods.description: Append one canonical base64 chunk at the exact acknowledged upload offset. Reuse the original command receipt after transport loss, never invent a retry identity.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/assessment.v1
methods.description: Read one exact render or review report. List headers are projections and do not carry another mutable assessment.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/catalog.v1
methods.description: Read the exact supported native creation/edit schemas, format limits and configured rendering engines before creating or editing deliverables.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/create.v1
methods.description: Create an editable DOCX, XLSX or PPTX from the catalog's content schema. Author provenance is not independently verified evidence. Formula results require explicit recalculation.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/discard.v1
methods.description: Discard the specified staging upload. This does not remove a published deliverable.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/download.v1
methods.description: Read bounded bytes from an exact immutable asset. Verify the complete size and SHA-256 before saving; file saving is a separate host operation.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/edit.v1
methods.description: Apply catalog-defined local native edits to the exact current revision. Unaffected package parts are preserved; stale revisions are refused. A new revision has no inherited render or review.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/export.v1
methods.description: Prepare the exact native revision, its existing rendered PDF, one XLSX sheet as CSV (sheetPart required), or a delivery ZIP with native source, current derivatives and evidence manifest. CSV refuses missing/error formula caches and protects formula-like strings. This never sends or publishes a file.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/history.v1
methods.description: Read immutable revision history; previous previews and reviews do not apply to later revisions.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/import.v1
methods.description: Import the completed, hash-verified native upload, preserving its admitted original bytes. Unsafe or unsupported packages are refused without silent feature stripping.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/list.v1
methods.description: List retained deliverables newest first. Content and evidence remain owned by exact immutable native revisions.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/read.v1
methods.description: Inspect a deliverable and exact native revision, its editable item identities and source-bound checks. Omitting revision reads the current head once.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/recalculate.v1
methods.description: Recalculate an XLSX through confined LibreOffice into a new native revision. Conversion may change Office formatting; the exact original is retained. Inspect resulting formula errors and missing caches.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/remove.v1
methods.description: Remove one deliverable and its native/derived bytes only if the expected current revision still matches. Original receipts remain and cannot resurrect removed content.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/render.v1
methods.description: Render the exact native revision through configured confined LibreOffice/Poppler. Record actual engine versions, PDF/page hashes and extraction checks; successful rendering does not establish visual correctness.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/review.v1
methods.description: Record the caller's visual review of enumerated pages from an exact render. This is attributed review evidence, not an automatic quality certification or approval to publish.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/upload.v1
methods.description: Reserve a bounded native-file upload for the exact size and SHA-256. No host path or URL is read.

methods.name: flame.deliverables/uploads.v1
methods.description: Read admitted staging uploads and their current acknowledged offsets. Reselect only bytes matching the declared SHA-256 to resume.
